fixtures.name: fact
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT i AS id, (CASE WHEN i % 23 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE i % 997 END)::BIGINT AS fk, (i * 1.25)::DOUBLE AS amt, (i % 7)::BIGINT AS q, (i % 997)::BIGINT * 100003 AS sfk FROM range(1, 20000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 4096)

fixtures.name: dim
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT k AS pk, 'kind' || (k % 13) AS kind, (k % 5)::BIGINT AS grp, (k * 10)::INTEGER AS w FROM range(1, 801) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 256)

fixtures.name: dim_dup
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT k % 400 + 1 AS pk, (k % 5)::BIGINT AS grp FROM range(1, 801) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)

fixtures.name: dim_sparse
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT k * 100003 AS spk, (k % 3)::BIGINT AS sgrp FROM range(0, 997, 2) t(k)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET)
